FN-FKWMYC5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 16
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/19/2026
Senate Bill 16 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by approximately $32,000 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information
provided by the entity, by exempting Sleep in Heavenly Peace, Inc., from paying state sales and
use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to counties and municipalities by
approximately $42,000 annually, dependent upon the amount of taxable supplies purchased in
the county or municipality.
Page 1

FN-FKWMYC5-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 16
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/28/2026
Senate Bill 16 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by approximately $32,000
annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027 and ending in Fiscal Year 2029, based on information
provided by the entity, by exempting Sleep in Heavenly Peace, Inc., from paying state sales and
use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to counties and municipalities by
approximately $42,000 annually provided the respective local governments adopt an exemption
from local sales and use taxes, pursuant to this bill.
